sections.heading: Ranbir Kapoor — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Ranbir Kapoor was born on 25 September 1982 in Mumbai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Rishi Kapoor and his mother, Neetu Singh. He is a sibling of Riddhima Kapoor Sahni.
He studied at Lee Strasberg Theatre and Film Institute, Bombay Scottish School and H. R. College of Commerce and Economics.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi.
